conplag.ground_truth: Source labels.csv plagiarism verdicts for programming-contest submission pairs.
conplag.selection: All 911 labeled pairs using the raw version_1 Java submissions; preserve source labels and row order.

irplag.ground_truth: Original, independently written, and deliberately plagiarized submissions distinguished by source directory annotations.
irplag.selection: All 460 original/submission labeled pairs. Retrieval uses all 355 positively judged submissions against seven originals; exclude 105 submissions with no positive qrel from ranking-only evaluation. Retain source labels including the disputed non-plagiarized submissions described in its README.

ipca.ground_truth: Adapter-derived within-course/assignment pair labels from source P/NP, solution and variant filename annotations; not an independently annotated pair manifest.
ipca.selection: All 270 pairs generated by the versioned Matheel IPCA filename-label adapter from the 60 labeled .txt submissions; ignore .ast files.

criminal_minds.ground_truth: Source original/plagiarized submission lineage. Adapter labels matching original/plagiarized lineage positive and different original lineage negative.
criminal_minds.selection: All 350 adapter-derived original-to-plagiarized comparisons from ten original and 35 plagiarized submissions; concatenate Java files per submission in stable relative-path order.

student_code_similarity.ground_truth: Source cheating_dataset.csv manually curated simulated student-submission cheating/not-cheating labels.
student_code_similarity.selection: All 293 source labeled pairs. Exclude cheating_features_dataset.csv because it contains derived features rather than the original pair annotations.

soco14.ground_truth: Undirected source-code reuse pairs from the updated test qrels; represented in the plagiarism track as source reuse ground truth, not an inference of misconduct.
soco14.selection: Matheel judged-endpoint retrieval: separate C/C++ and Java, and six scenarios per language. Use all valid judged endpoints as queries and candidates within each nonempty language/scenario. Add reciprocal relevance because source pairs are undirected, exclude self matches, and record every qrel referencing an absent file. This is not the full-corpus SOCO competition protocol.
